source_facts: Fp8LinearMethod selects GroupShape(1, weight_block_size[0]) activations and GroupShape(weight_block_size) weights when block quantization is configured.
CutlassFp8BlockScaledMMKernel requires dynamic activation GroupShape(1,128) and consumes block scales through ops.cutlass_scaled_mm.
Every bound Gemma linear K and N dimension is exactly divisible by 128.
causal_successor.hypothesis: Local 1x128 activation scales and 128x128 weight scales reduce quantization error below NRMSE 0.03 while retaining a positive request-normalized B200 speed contribution.
